Theorem
[Arithmetic Lobachevsky volume formula] \group arithmetic-volume ↗ thurston-ch07-bianchi-covolume ↗ thurston-ch07-lobachevsky-fourier Source: thurston:page-0182, thurston:page-0183

With $D$ and the quadratic symbol as above, \[ \operatorname {Vol}(H^3/\operatorname {PSL}(2,\mathcal O_d)) =\frac D{12}\sum _{k\bmod D}\left(\frac{-D}{k}\right)\Lambda (\pi k/D). \]
Proof

\sketch Hecke’s identity expresses the zeta quotient as $\sum _{n>0}(\frac{-D}{n})n^{-s}$. Apply the finite Fourier transform identity

\[ \sum _{k\bmod D}\left(\frac{-D}{k}\right)e^{2\pi ikn/D}=\sqrt{-D}\left(\frac{-D}{n}\right) \]

at $s=2$, take imaginary parts using the Fourier series of $\Lambda $, and multiply by $D/24$.
